delete.summary: Permanently delete an API key (cannot be undone)
delete.description: Permanently revokes and deletes the specified API key. This action cannot be undone. The last admin key in a cluster cannot be deleted. The `{id_or_token}` path segment accepts either a key UUID (`id`) or the full API key token (`token`, for example `rt_...`).

parameters.description: Free-text search across log ID, method, path, status, source, user agent, and errors.

parameters.name: status_codes

parameters.name: host
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring of the request host.

parameters.name: start_time
parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound using a RawTree-compatible datetime string.

parameters.name: end_time
parameters.description: Inclusive upper bound using a RawTree-compatible datetime string.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of rows to return (default 50, max 200).

parameters.name: organization
parameters.description: Organization name. Required for user and OAuth sessions.

parameters.name: cluster
parameters.description: Cluster name. Required only when the organization has multiple clusters.

parameters.name: database
parameters.description: Database containing splunk_events. Database-bound API keys may omit this parameter.

get.summary: List all tables in a database

post.summary: Create a table in the selected database
Verify customer-owned S3 access for a table
Insert data into a table (auto-creates table if needed). URL imports wait for completion and return JSON.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Optional source URL. Mutually exclusive with request body.

parameters.name: query_id
parameters.description: Optional query ID for correlating a URL import with ClickHouse query logs.

parameters.name: columns
parameters.description: Optional comma-separated column names for TSV data when using transform=firehose.

parameters.name: deduplicate_insert
parameters.description: Optional ClickHouse insert deduplication setting: enable or disable.

parameters.name: insert_deduplication_token
parameters.description: Optional custom ClickHouse insert deduplication token.

requestBody.description: A single JSON object or array of objects. Mutually exclusive with the 'url' query parameter.

200.description: Body mode returns JSON {inserted}. Firehose transform returns JSON {requestId,timestamp}. URL mode returns JSON {inserted}; inserted is null when unavailable. The ClickHouse query ID is returned in X-ClickHouse-Query-Id.

400.description: Invalid sorting key, or the table does not exist.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Inclusive Unix milliseconds. Defaults to the last 24 hours.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Inclusive Unix milliseconds. Defaults to the last 24 hours.

size.description: Resources per replica, one of the sizes returned by /v1/clusters/sizes.

idle_timeout_minutes.description: Minutes without activity before automatically pausing. Omit to use the configured default.

cluster_id.description:
Optional client-generated UUID. The UI uses it to preview the
immutable S3 database-bucket tag before IAM setup; API clients may
omit it and let the backend generate one.

oneOf.description:
Optional database-level customer-owned S3 configuration. Tables that
omit their own configuration inherit this storage.

name.description: Table name in the selected database.

oneOf.description:
Optional customer-owned S3 configuration for this table. Omit it to
inherit database-level storage when configured, then the cluster default.

sorting_key.description:
Optional comma-separated SQL sorting expressions. Omit it, or send an empty string,
to let the table pick a key per part from the ingested data.

oneOf.description:
Explicit database-level customer-owned S3 storage. `null` means that
the database inherits the cluster's default storage.

sorting_key.description: Sorting key expressions in key order, empty when the table picks a key per part.

id.description: Existing destination ID. Omit when adding a destination.

url.description: Omit on update to preserve the configured URL.

headers.description:
Omit the map to preserve all headers. Within a supplied map, null
preserves the stored value for the same case-insensitive name.

id.description: Existing destination ID. Omit when adding a destination.

header_names.description: Configured header names. Values are never returned.

ErrorResponse.description: Error response shape returned by all endpoints.

uuid.description: OpenStatus-compatible identifier for the request span.

level.description: OpenStatus-compatible request level derived from the HTTP status.

url_query.description: Raw URL query string of the request, for example `format=json&limit=10`.

request_body.description: Captured request body (textual bodies up to 8 KiB; empty otherwise).

format.description: Optional ClickHouse output format. Defaults to JSON.

executed_at.description: Time the captured execution started, supplied with the completed result.

sorting_key.description: Comma-separated SQL expressions for the custom sorting key.

apiKeyAuth.description: Cluster-wide API key (rt_<hex>) sent as Authorization: Bearer rt_<hex>. Obtain from POST /v1/keys.

bearerAuth.description: User JWT sent as Authorization: Bearer <jwt>.

scopes.full_access: Full agent access except billing, payments, identity/security administration, OAuth grant management, and staff routes.

oauth2.description: Public OAuth clients must use Authorization Code with PKCE (S256). Register clients at POST /oauth/register.
